newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market firmer, small-caps in demand.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market firmer, small-caps in demand.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed higher on Wednesday, helped by strong demand for shares with small capitalisations, traders said.
They said investors would remain focused on small caps on Thursday. Operators expected posible further declines on some blue chips due to thin demand.
Gainers outnumbered decliners on Wednesday by 188 to 87. Closing prices for 235 stocks stayed flat.
Three independent indices computed by securities companies based on average prices and market capitalisation posted higher levels from previous session.
The VAB-RA all-share index was up 1.52 percent to 6,580.4 points, BIG-OTC rose by 1.4 percent to 5,111.84 and CAS-RQ climbed 1.52 percent to 1,148 points.
Among the small-cap gainers was rubber utilities maker Rolast. It closed 100 lei firmer to 2,700 in heavy trading.

Oil refineries in high demand in recent weeks saw same correction on Wednesday. Traders said foreign investors were reluctant to buy stakes in refineries due to high prices, but they forecast a new buying wave due to their higher liquidity.
Petrobrazi oil refinery closed 6,000 lei weaker at 47,000 under selling pressure, while Arpechim refinery lost 6,500 lei to close at 46,500.
Steel mill Sidex inched up 300 lei to 24,500 in late trading.
Overall turnover rose to 32.6 billion lei on Wednesday from 30.5 billion previously.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD and CAS-RQ on CASE02. ($=7,147 lei)
